[[Adar Tallon/Legends|Adar Tallon]] and a team of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] [[operative]]s '''escaped''' from [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].

==Battle==
Having survived a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] assault led by [[Jodo Kast]] on his [[Fort Tusken/Legends|home]], [[Adar Tallon/Legends|Adar Tallon]] agreed to leave [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] forces that had arrived to protect him. Tallon and the Alliance operatives arrived in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] with the intent of leaving the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] aboard their [[Starship/Legends|starship]], the ''[[Alabak's Gold]]''.<ref name="TM" />

The [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Relentless (Dorja)|Relentless]]'' arrived in the [[Tatoo system/Legends|Tatoo system]] to secure Tallon. The local [[Imperial Prefect]], [[Orun Depp]], ordered Mos Eisley to be secured by his small [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] force and ordered the [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] closed and all civilians off the streets.<ref name="TM" />

The Alliance team arrived at [[Docking Bay 94/Legends|Docking Bay 94]] to collect their ship, only to find the Prefect and his stormtroopers waiting for them. The Alliance operatives and the Imperial forces engaged in a [[lightfight]], which was interrupted by the [[Assassin droid/Legends|assassin droid]] [[IG-72/Legends|IG-72]], intent on claiming the [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] on Tallon. The droid gunned down the remaining Imperial forces before focusing on the Rebels, however they managed to defeat the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] and escape from Mos Eisley.<ref name="TM" />

The ''Alabak's Gold'', reinforced with [[Z-95 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95 Headhunters]] allied to Tallon, faced off against three [[TIE/IN interceptor/Legends|TIE/IN interceptors]] above Tatooine. Fending off the Imperial forces, the Alliance ships jumped to [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] and escaped.<ref name="TM" />
